notes: Gate name board of a Buddhist temple in Jongno, Seoul, written in Hanja and read right to left (left-to-right order on the board is 寺 覺 大). Hangul name for search: 대각사. Secondary target: a blue road-name address plate (Korean 도로명주소 format: road name over building number) on the wall at right; the number 87 is clear but the road name is too small and blurred to transcribe (appears to end in '...로10길'). Small vertical Hangul plaque on the left pillar is a distractor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
